import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# List of documentation method columns
doc_columns = [
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Not_Documented',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Vision_Document',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Requirements_Lists',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Goal_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Use_Case_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Prototypes',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_User_Stories',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_BDD_Scenarios',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_MLCanvas',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Notebooks',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Data_Models',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Others',
    'Q10_ML_Documentation_Others_Free'
]

# Convert the documentation method columns to numeric, handling non-numeric values
for col in doc_columns:
    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with NaN values in the documentation method columns
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=doc_columns)

# Calculate the mean for each documentation method
doc_means = df_clean[doc_columns].mean()

# Identify the two documentation methods with the lowest mean values
least_used = doc_means.sort_values().head(2)
least_used
